title: Spec of an integral ring map is a closed map
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings with $S$ integral over $R$. Then the induced map $\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, $\mathfrak q\mapsto\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$, is a closed map for the Zariski topologies: the image of every closed subset of $\operatorname{Spec}S$ is closed in $\operatorname{Spec}R$.
